decisions.quote:
This study replicates Hofstede’s
study with data obtained from students studying for their master degrees in different universities in Jordan.
decisions.reason: The study collects new primary survey data from 795 master's students across universities in Jordan using the VSM 94 questionnaire to re-test whether Hofstede's (1980) published cultural dimension findings for Arab countries hold in Jordan. Both shipped and blind coding rightly classify the record as a replication.

decisions.quote:
This study replicates Hofstede’s study in the same way; using a matched sample on as many
characteristics as possible (age and education). A total of 795 graduate students have participated in this study of
which 375 were males and 420 were females.
decisions.location: Independent parent primary-source check; exhausted_candidate_0056.parent.json offsets
decisions.reason: Parent independently inspected the Jordan new795participant matched-sample survey, VSM94 dimensions, IBM Arab-culture benchmark and the actual shipped520unique Hofstede Culture's Consequences identity. This is a retest of the cultural-dimension finding already represented by that row, not a separately identified empirical original. The inline1980 citation versus shipped1999 is retained as bibliographic uncertainty; no unverified later-printing or edition history is asserted and no extra book is manufactured from the year difference. This missing-pair disposition does not adjudicate the exact edition/year of the shipped original.
